summary: This Form 6-K filed by XP Inc., a Cayman Islands foreign private issuer, contains Notice of the 2026 Annual General Meeting, proxy statement, and form of proxy card. The AGM will be held on May 29, 2026, to consider and vote on ordinary resolutions including approval of consolidated financial statements for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, and the appointment/re-appointment of directors Thiago Simoes Maffra, José de Menezes Berenguer Neto, Guilherme Dias Fernandes Benchimol, Bruno Constantino Alexandre dos Santos, Martin Emiliano Escobari Lifchitz, José Luiz Acar Pedro, Oscar Rodriguez Herrero, João Roberto Gonçalves Teixeira, and Melissa Werneck, each for a two-year term. This is a routine AGM notice and proxy solicitation, equivalent to a U.S. proxy statement filing. No special situation is present; it is an ordinary meeting notice with director elections and financial statement ratification.
